question.problem: Given the **orthonormal** basis $B=\{[\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{5} \\ \frac{4}{5}\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}-\frac{4}{5} \\ \frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}]\}$ of ${R}^{2},$ find $[x]_{B}$ if $x=[\begin{aligned}-20 \\ 10\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
Let's denote the vectors of $B$ as ${q}_{1},\,{q}_{2}.$ 

Since $B$ is an orthonormal basis, we have that $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$, where ${x}_{i}=x\cdot {q}_{i}.$ Computing the components of $x,$ we get the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & =[\begin{aligned}-20 \\ 10\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{5} \\ \frac{4}{5}\end{aligned}]=-12+8=-4 \\ {x}_{2} & =[\begin{aligned}-20 \\ 10\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}-\frac{4}{5} \\ \frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}]=16+6=22\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have 

$$
[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 22\end{aligned}].
$$
